purpose: Run deterministic, local repository project checks and produce human, JSON and badge outputs without uploading source.
rationale: GitHub is already central to the Xroga product and the Action can provide useful read-only value with contents:read permissions.
A dependency-free deterministic engine can also power a local CLI without creating a second checker.
External version tags and satellite extraction remain blocked until licensing and release policy are approved.
blockers: OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED: define semantic version and immutable release-tag policy.

purpose: Expose the same deterministic project-check engine as a local, no-telemetry CLI.
rationale: The local CLI is functional in the main repository but is not published as a package.
Package-name availability, licensing and release provenance must be resolved before registry publication.
blockers: OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED: approve licensing and package publication identity.

purpose: Orchestrate the real project-check engine with explicit read-only permissions and evidence outputs.
rationale: The skill contract is implemented and references a real tool instead of promising unsupported repair or deployment.
blockers: OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED: approve distribution license and target skill ecosystem.

rationale: The Action is the safer first wedge; no MCP server is shipped until transport, client compatibility and permission boundaries are independently reviewed.
No mutation, external-write, production or destructive tool is exposed.
blockers: Marketplace and client metadata require current official validation when MCP work begins.

purpose: Future reproducible benchmark fixtures and raw results.
rationale: No completed reproducible study or public-safe raw dataset exists, so publishing a benchmark repository would be an empty vanity artifact.
blockers: Real methodology, fixtures, raw data and limitations are required.

rationale: No standalone example repository is created until a complete starting state, task, evidence and limitations package exists.
blockers: A public-safe complete example and approved license are required.
